interface.shortDescription: Run managed agents with shared project conventions.
interface.longDescription: Provides four public Skills: Agent for complete local workflows in direct, work, work-verification, and plan-work-verification modes, Convention for shared rules, authority, and core semantics, Document for authoring, storage, and Codex synchronization, and Tool, a catalog of the plugin scripts. No MCP package, server, account, tenant, connection, or authenticated resource is required.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent to orchestrate the next request through the appropriate managed role.
